info.title: fleett API
info.description: Control plane for fleet-managed Hermes agents. Every /api route except GET /api/health, GET /api/auth/config and GET /api/openapi.json requires a bearer token (Authorization: Bearer <token>) or a fleett_session cookie. Mutations require the admin role. Browser-facing /auth/login, /auth/callback and /auth/logout are outside /api and are intentionally omitted from this document.
